Kim / Aditya / Alex / Priya —

Quick feature-level econ summary (high level; workbook attached: redwood-feature-econ-v2.xlsx):

Assumptions used (from samples + typical prod shaping):
- Total monthly events: 1,024,000 (rounded ~1M)
- Distribution: search 60% (614k events), summarization 25% (256k), triage 15% (154k)
- Avg tokens per event: search 1.8k, summarization 3.2k, triage 2.4k
- Tokenization overhead and metadata adds ~8% to token count used for billing

Baseline cost (hosted):
- Estimated $/1M tokens (hosted, mixed-precision, continuous batching): $10,800 per 1M tokens
- For the 1M-event profile above that maps to ~3.2M tokens/month -> baseline monthly inference cost: ~$34.6k

Reserved (committed) price bands (approx):
- Pilot (small reserved): 10–20% discount -> effective $/1M tokens: ~$9,720
- Mid (3–6 months commit): 20–35% discount -> effective $/1M tokens: ~$7,020–$8,640
- Committed enterprise (annual): 35–50% discount -> effective $/1M tokens: ~$5,400–$7,020

$/feature-month (estimates using distribution above):
- Contextual search: $1,250 (hosted) -> reserved mid: ~$850
- Summarization: $1,900 (hosted) -> reserved mid: ~$1,300
- Triage bot: $980 (hosted) -> reserved mid: ~$680

CAC payback scenarios (assumptions: revenue per converted user $60/year, conversion lift conservative x1.2, aggressive x1.6):
- With hosted pricing and conservative uplift: payback ~9–12 months (outside ICix 6-month target).
- With mid reserved pricing and conservative uplift: payback ~6–8 months (close to target).
- With committed pricing and aggressive uplift: payback ~4–6 months (meets target).

Margin targets vs inference cost (gross margin on feature revenue, assume feature incremental revenue $5k/month each initially):
- Hosted baseline: margin ~ (5k - feature-cost)/5k -> summary: search ~ -25% (loss), summarization ~ -38% (loss), triage ~ -20% (loss).
- Mid reserved: margins improve to +8% (search), -? summarization small negative -> see workbook for exact cells. Critical point: without reserved pricing and quantization, margins do not meet target 30–40%.

Key recommendations / next steps:
1) Propose pilot with mid reserved band (3-month commit) to bridge cost gap and achieve near-6 month payback.
2) Run a short quantization & batching experiment (Marissa / Infra) to see model-level token cost delta (int8 vs fp16) — expected 10–25% improvement on token $/1M.
3) Pilot scope: start with contextual search + triage (two features) to reduce initial token count and shorten payback window; add summarization in month 2.
4) Draft pilot SOW and pricing bands for Alex/Priya — Aditya / Kim to own commercial.

Deliverables by Mon 4/19:
- One-slide summary for execs (Marissa)
- Pilot SOW + commercial options (Aditya / Kimberly)
- Quantization experiment plan (Marissa / Infra)

Alex / Priya — happy to hop on 30 min tomorrow if you'd like to walk through the numbers; otherwise we'll present the one-slide before your 4/21 sync.

Thanks,
